attorneys: Henry Kaiser, Eugene Gressman, George Kaufmann and David I. Ashe for petitioners. Godfrey P. Schmidt for respondents. David E. Feller, Elliot Bredhoff, Jerry D. Anker and Michael H. Gottesman for Industrial Union Department, AFL-CIO, as amicus curiae, in support of the petition.

opinions.text:
